mapping: The M1 sheet is not in this repository. Which test stands for which M1 check is this demo's reading of A1, A2, A8 and C1-C7; Sash confirms it before A14 is booked.

checks.C1: provider read outside its storage root is refused
checks.C2: provider write outside its storage root is refused
checks.C3: provider file beside its root, under the parent, is refused
checks.C4: a program other than the bound provider binary is refused
checks.C6: provider start is refused when its profile cannot be applied
checks.C7: a refused provider start names its reason

agent-conformance.label: real elastos binary through lab/agent-conformance
agent-conformance.runner_reason: its harness builds elastos with Cargo inside the test; under any other parent than cargo test that build starts again, so the run uses cargo test with the environment run.sh used
agent-conformance.macos_reason: lab/agent-conformance supports the Mac data path and darwin component platforms only

did-provider.label: did-provider under its confine.sb
did-provider.macos_reason: the provider profile runs under /usr/bin/sandbox-exec, which only macOS has

wallet-provider.label: wallet-provider under its confine.sb
wallet-provider.macos_reason: the provider profile runs under /usr/bin/sandbox-exec, which only macOS has

model-provider.label: model-provider under its confine.sb
model-provider.macos_reason: the provider profile runs under /usr/bin/sandbox-exec, which only macOS has

steps.title: The Runtime's Wasmtime admits the real agent-host component
steps.reason: it compiles in the Runtime's own Wasmtime, imports only the five elastos:bus@1.0.0 interfaces, loads twice as separate instances and keeps its journal head across a compaction

steps.title: A component with an import outside the Bus is refused
steps.reason: component import "..." is not allowed; the Runtime refuses it before the compute provider loads anything

steps.title: An unsigned or untrusted capsule is refused at launch
steps.reason: "is unsigned" for no signature, "verification failed" for another key or a changed entrypoint; nothing loads, and the trusted key's capsule then loads once

steps.title: With both grants, the agent host writes and reads its journal
steps.reason: it asks to write, then read, its own journal under the person's .AppData/Agents/agent-host folder; the real bridge stores it encrypted and the guest reads back journal format 2

steps.title: With both grants denied, the agent host stores nothing
steps.reason: the shell answers both journal requests with "not now"; the guest finishes, makes no provider call, and no journal file exists

steps.title: An old-format journal is refused with its reason
steps.reason: "journal format 1 not supported; start a new task"; the stored journal is not changed

steps.title: A capsule cannot read a host SSH key
steps.reason: Internal("capsule manifest does not declare authority for localhost://Public/../../../../.ssh/id_ed25519") from the real elastos binary; the fake key bytes stay unchanged and never reach the output, and the operator makes no decision

steps.title: did-provider cannot read outside its storage root
steps.reason: the provider answers storage_error and returns none of the outside file's bytes

steps.title: wallet-provider cannot read a key in another wallet
steps.reason: opening the planted key is the refused step; the provider answers storage_error

steps.title: model-provider cannot read a run record outside its root
steps.reason: the outside run record is neither read nor returned, and the provider stays in service

steps.title: did-provider cannot write outside its storage root
steps.reason: the provider answers storage_error and nothing appears outside the root

steps.title: wallet-provider cannot create a wallet outside its root
steps.reason: Init for an unrelated base answers storage_error and no wallet directory appears

steps.title: model-provider cannot use a journal root outside its own
steps.reason: the outside journal root cannot even be inspected; init answers journal_corrupt

steps.title: did-provider ignores a file planted beside its root
steps.reason: the planted file under the storage parent is neither read nor written; the provider answers storage_error

steps.title: wallet-provider ignores a key planted beside its root
steps.reason: the planted key is not read or adopted; the provider answers storage_error

steps.title: did-provider profile refuses a copy of the provider binary
steps.reason: sandbox-exec exits 71 and logs the refused execvp() with "Operation not permitted"

steps.title: wallet-provider profile refuses a copy of the provider binary
steps.reason: sandbox-exec exits 71 and logs the refused execvp() with "Operation not permitted"

steps.title: model-provider profile refuses a copy of the provider binary
steps.reason: the copy never answers init; sandbox-exec exits 71 with "Operation not permitted" and nothing is written

steps.title: did-provider profile denies every network operation
steps.reason: the profile starts (version 1) and (deny default), denies network* and holds no network allow

steps.title: wallet-provider profile denies every network operation
steps.reason: the profile starts (version 1) and (deny default), denies network* and holds no network allow

steps.title: model-provider hosted run fails closed under its profile
steps.reason: under confine.sb the hosted run cannot reach the Runtime socket, so it fails closed

steps.title: did-provider start is refused when its profile cannot be applied
steps.reason: a missing, broken or unbound profile stops the start before the provider runs

steps.title: wallet-provider start is refused when its profile cannot be applied
steps.reason: a missing, broken or unbound profile stops the start before the provider runs

steps.title: model-provider start is refused when its profile cannot be applied
steps.reason: a missing profile, a profile with its last bracket removed, or an unbound STORAGE_ROOT each refuse the start

steps.title: A refused did-provider start names its reason
steps.reason: sandbox-exec does not start the provider, and the failure names the request and the exit status

steps.title: A refused wallet-provider start names its reason
steps.reason: sandbox-exec does not start the provider, and the failure names the request and the exit status
